sloka: प्रेषिता भरतेनैव भ्रात्रा तव यवीयसा ।स हि सेनाम् समुत्थाप्य क्षिप्रमेवोपयास्यति ॥६-८-१५॥।।
transliteration: preṣitā bharatenaiva bhrātrā tava yavīyasā ।sa hi senām samutthāpya kṣipramevopayāsyati ॥6-8-15॥।।

translations.english: "'We have been sent by your younger brother Bharata and he is coming here very soon with the army."
